root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the of_node_put(child) call before the check for !subchild, ensuring it is always executed. The commit message states: "if fails to get subchild, it returns without calling of_node_put(child), causing the device node reference leak." This matches the diff where of_node_put(child) was originally after the if (!subchild) return; and is now placed before that check.
